integrity: The all-dimension proof uses an explicit unitary unitriangular factorization and stabilizer computation; an independently coded small-field exhaustive check is included. Some closely related journal full texts were inaccessible and priority remains provisional. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The explicit result concerns reversal–Frobenius self-adjoint idempotents in upper triangular matrices over a quadratic finite-field extension; it does not classify all involutions or arbitrary incidence algebras. Quantitative limits fix the field size. Small-field exhaustive tests support but cannot replace the characteristic-free proof.
title: Square-root rank fibers of self-adjoint triangular idempotents
